title: Philadelphia-Style Tomato Pie with Garlic, Oregano and Pecorino
changes_from_base: A thick, airy, focaccia-like dough proved in an oiled tray replaces the thin round base, and a slow-simmered garlic, butter and oregano tomato sauce takes the place of mozzarella; it is eaten at room temperature with just a dusting of pecorino.
summary: Rectangular tomato pizza with a garlicky, oregano-scented sauce and a puffy crust, finished with sharp pecorino and served at room temperature.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 33 x 45 cm

ingredients.item: extra-virgin olive oil, for the tray
tinned whole peeled tomatoes, blended until roughly smooth
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make Dough
steps.text: Whisk flour (500 g), salt (10 g) and yeast (5 g) together, add oil (33 ml) and water (325 ml), knead on low about 3 min, rest 10 min, then knead on low again for 10 min until it clears the sides but sticks at the base.

steps.title: Make Sauce
steps.text: Melt butter (30 g) with oil (30 ml), add garlic, oregano and chilli flakes, cook about 1 min until fragrant, add blended tomatoes (800 g tinned), sugar (1 tbsp) and a whole shallot, simmer about 45 min until thick, stirring occasionally, season with salt (½ tsp), remove the shallot and cool.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Oil the tray (33 x 45 cm) with oil (45 ml), set the dough on it as a ball and turn to coat, cover loosely and leave somewhere warm 1 h, then push and stretch into the corners, cover and prove 1 h more.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C on the upper-middle shelf, dimple the middle with fingertips and create a 2.5 cm raised rim, spread sauce generously leaving the rim bare, bake about 20 min, turning the tray halfway, until the edges are crisp and light golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool at least 15 min, scatter finely grated pecorino romano (15 g) and cut into squares.

tips: Make the dough the day before to develop deep flavour and ease handling
Cook the sauce slowly until reduced to concentrate the tomato taste and remove excess moisture
Cool the pizza thoroughly before topping with cheese so it sits on the surface rather than sinking into warmth
storage: Cool completely then keep chilled for up to 2 days, serving at room temperature or warming briefly in a low oven if preferred. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
